lex: The College of William and Mary is the owner of the Alan B. Miller Hall at 101 Ukrop Way in Virginia, which was the design of Robert A.M. Stern. The building of the hall started on the 30th of March 2007 and completed on the 1st of June 2009. The Mason School of Business are the current tenants of the building.
